versions.content: Pseudo parallel client interaction according to ISO Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support the parallelism defined by the ISO as pseudo parallel concept, which is defined in ISO 14229-1 under Figure J.2. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Use Case: Support of scenarios, where testers in parallel is only allowed, when in default session. Supporting Material: ISO 14229-1
